Hi team —

We can provide the requested items. Summary of what I’ll share and notes on redaction/handling: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report:
- We have a current SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 period. We will provide a redacted PDF (removing customer-identifying sections) and deliver via secure link.
- Attachment (to be delivered securely): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf

2) SSO / SAML metadata:
- We can provide SP metadata and a sample SAML Assertion example, plus an implementation checklist (expected NameID format, certificate rollover cadence).
- Files: Redwood_SSO_SAML_Metadata.xml (SP metadata), SAML_Implementation_Notes.txt

3) SCIM provisioning:
- We support SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning. I’ll attach the provisioning guide and sample JSON payloads. We support bulk sync and on-demand provisioning; SCIM auth uses bearer tokens scoped to a customer-provisioning role.
- Attachment: Redwood_SCIM_Provisioning_Guide.pdf

4) RBAC & admin controls:
- Document covering role hierarchy, admin scopes, audit logging for role changes, and emergency admin procedures.
- Attachment: RBAC_Admin_Controls.docx

5) Vendor questionnaire
- I’ll take the XLSX and fill standard security controls; for any controls requiring legal/DPA language we’ll loop in Lauren.

Estimated timeline:
- Initial package (SOC2 redacted + SAML metadata + SCIM guide + RBAC doc + partially completed questionnaire): 48–72 hours.
- Finalized questionnaire + any legal redlines: 3–5 business days depending on complexity.

Note on sensitive files: per policy we should not send full SOC 2 or internal logs over email; I’ll upload to our secure file share and provide a link with expiration.

Connor — please add SCIM endpoint examples and expected attribute mappings so I can include them in the package.

Thanks,
